summary: You build the core of the assistant in memory: a local embedder (and a fake one for tests), an index that returns the top 3 documents, a prompt that labels each source, and two guards (a minimum score and a prompt rule) so it can say it does not know. It answers with source names, and three tests need no key and no download.
goal: Embed the knowledge base, take the top 3 for a question, answer with a source name, and say when you do not know.

items.text: Part A: write down the four parts, what each takes and returns, and which two need a fake
Part B: write the embedder and the index, and see error-e101 first for the monitor question
Part C: write build_prompt and answer_question with top_k and min_score
Part D: write three tests with fakes and see them pass with no key and no download
Parts E and F: ask three questions, then set min_score to 0 and see what the coffee question does
Parts G and H: try one real answer, write the note and README, then commit and push
Play the Retrieval Referee game to the end and see your score
